# [CS038] Unsafe HTTP Client Configuration (http-client-unsafe)

An HTTP client without a timeout is used, such as http.DefaultClient.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-400](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/400.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Without Client.Timeout or a request context deadline, a slow or malicious server keeps the request, its goroutine and its connection open indefinitely.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
resp, err := http.Get(url)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
resp, err := client.Get(url)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [http-client-unsafe]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    http-client-unsafe: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore http-client-unsafe -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** http-client-unsafe
```
